Sorry for yet another request for the dump loader.

For errors occurring when loading data, could you add the name of the
variable for which there was a problem to the error message? It would make
tracking down errors much easier. Right now, error messages like the
following are cryptic:

Error : mismatch in number dimensions declared and found in context;
processing stage=data initialization; dims declared=(1); dims found=()
